title: What an Owner May Do in the Days After a Certificate of Deposit Matures
content:
On every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line a maturity notice is mailed the number of calendar days before the maturity date that the tier publishes. On the maturity date interest is credited and the certificate passes into its grace period.

## 1. What the grace period permits

During grace the owner may do any of the following, and none of them carries a penalty.

- Add funds, on a tier that accepts deposits during grace, in single deposits of at least the smallest grace deposit the tier accepts and, in total across the grace period, no more than the tier's largest total for one grace period.
- Withdraw part of the balance, on a tier that permits it.
- Withdraw everything and close the certificate.
- Renew into a different tier, on a tier that permits a change of term.

A withdrawal taken during grace is a grace-period withdrawal and carries no penalty.

## 2. The window

Grace actions are allowed only while no more than the calendar days the tier publishes as its grace period have passed after the maturity date. Days are counted with the day after the maturity date as day 1, and grace actions are allowed while the current date is on or before the maturity date plus that number of days. The maturity date is read from the certificate record.

### Boundary readings, on hypothetical dates

A certificate of a tier whose grace period is 10 days matures on 4 March.

| Current date | Last day of grace | May a grace action be taken |
|---|---|---|
| 13 March | 14 March | yes |
| 14 March | 14 March | yes; the boundary day itself is within the window |
| 15 March | 14 March | no |

## 3. The total added, and the single deposit

The two grace deposit figures bind on different things. The smaller binds on each deposit offered; the larger binds on the sum of the deposits taken across the one grace period. Two deposits of 150000.00 USD and 120000.00 USD offered in one grace period on a tier whose total is 250000.00 USD: the first is accepted, and the second would carry the total to 270000.00 USD and so exceeds what the tier accepts for the period.
